beachSetup.title: Beach settings
beachSetup.intro: Start with how many lines of umbrellas the beach has and how many umbrellas stand in each line. You can change everything afterwards on this page.
beachSetup.linesHint: New umbrellas get the default number (line × 100 + position). Only the last line can be removed. Umbrellas that were ever booked can't be removed.
beachSetup.numberingHint: Umbrellas are numbered line × 100 + position: 101, 102… in line 1, 201… in line 2. Position 1 is the leftmost facing the sea.
